::: {#announcements .callout-important title="Announcements"}

- **We will not meet on 21 November 2026**, to allow time for students
  registering late to complete their enrolment.
- **Before our first meeting on 28 November 2026, read
  the [Introduction](bulsu/discrete-math/lecture-notes/chapter_00.pdf),
  [Chapter 1](bulsu/discrete-math/lecture-notes/chapter_01.pdf) and
  [Chapter 2](bulsu/discrete-math/lecture-notes/chapter_02.pdf) carefully.**
- Chapters 1 and 2 revisit mathematical language and logic from MMW and
  develop the ideas further.
- **Bring a recent 1×1 photo to our first meeting on 28 November.** I will
  attach it to our fixed seating plan so I can identify you, check attendance
  more quickly and record your recitation marks.

:::
